calibration_sources: AWS Mountpoint for Amazon S3, `aws-c-s3` CRT (`s3torchconnector`), and S3 Express One Zone Architecture Benchmarks
s5cmd / Rust `object_store` (`obstore`) Parallel Byte-Range GET Throughput Studies on 100G–400G Instances
NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage `cuObject` (S3-over-RDMA) & Mooncake S3-RDMA Zero-Copy Transfer Papers

workload.node_network_spec: 8xH100/H200 Cloud Instance with 400 Gbps (50 GB/s theoretical line rate) network interface & 500 GB Checkpoint / Dataset Shard
workload.single_stream_s3_ceiling: Standard cloud object storage caps a single TCP HTTP GET stream to ~80–180 MB/s; saturating 400 Gbps requires 128–256 concurrent Byte-Range GET streams across multiple prefix partitions!
workload.posix_vs_object_mismatch: Object storage is immutable (no in-place random write, 50–80ms metadata STAT/LIST latency, HTTP 503 SlowDown at >3,500 PUT/5,500 GET per second per prefix)

tiers.name: Tier 1: 传统 Python `boto3` 默认下载 / 旧版 `s3fs-fuse` (单流瓶颈 + GIL 阻塞 = 仅 0.18 GB/s ✕)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Naive Python `boto3` / Legacy `s3fs-fuse` (Single-Stream Ceiling + GIL = 0.18 GB/s, 68ms TTFB)
tiers.recommended_for: Small config JSON files (<10 MB) only; leaves 99.6% of a 400Gbps GPU node's NIC idle and stalls 8 GPUs for 46 minutes per 500GB load.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 新一代 Rust FUSE 挂载 (`Mountpoint for S3` / `gcsfuse v2` + 本地 NVMe 缓存 = 11.8 GB/s)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Modern Rust FUSE (`Mountpoint for S3` / `gcsfuse v2` + Local NVMe Cache = 11.8 GB/s)
tiers.recommended_for: Drop-in POSIX file read compatibility for unmodified PyTorch training scripts reading large sequential tar/safetensors files.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 原生 C/Rust 128 并发分块 Range-GET (`aws-c-s3` CRT / `s5cmd` / `obstore` + 前缀哈希分片 = 26.5 GB/s)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Native C/Rust 128-Stream Parallel Range-GET (`aws-c-s3` CRT / `s5cmd` + Prefix Sharding = 26.5 GB/s)
tiers.recommended_for: Standard cloud S3 model weight distribution, PyTorch DCP s3torchconnector, and Ray Data high-throughput Parquet ingestion.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 同可用区低延迟层 (`S3 Express One Zone`) + `S3-over-RDMA` (`cuObject` / Mooncake 直写显存 = 44.2 GB/s 🏆)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Zonal Low-Latency Object Tier (`S3 Express One Zone`) + `S3-over-RDMA` (`cuObject` Direct-to-HBM = 44.2 GB/s)
tiers.recommended_for: Hyperscale checkpointing, serverless GPU cold start, and L3 KV cache offloading requiring 2.8ms TTFB and 44.2 GB/s zero-CPU-copy RDMA.
